{{Quote|Light repeating blasters have been added to squads in almost every sector, but the rearming effort has been sporadic everywhere but in three sectors where better than half of the line squads have been re-equipped: Shwuy, Harron and Nembus.|A compilation of Imperial documents by Rebel Alliance Major Arhul Hextrophon|<ref name="IS2" />}}
The '''Shwuy sector''' was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and contained the [[Uviuy Exen system/Legends|Uviuy Exen system]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uviuy Exen/Legends|Uviuy Exen]] was situated at the intersection of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Shwuy Exchange/Legends|Shwuy Exchange]].

Uviuy Exen was already a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]] and was a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], more than half of all the [[line squad]]s of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] in the Shwuy [[Sector/Legends|sector]] had been armed with [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blasters]]. During the later [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|struggle]] between the Empire and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Uviuy Exen was the site of a [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (6 ABY)|pair]] of [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (10 ABY)|battles]] between the two factions.

==Description==
The Shwuy [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="Northern Dependencies" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the area known as the [[Shwuy Perimeter]]<ref name="PP story">{{WEGCite|story=Entering 'The Life'|book=Pirates & Privateers}}</ref> and contained the [[Uviuy Exen system/Legends|Uviuy Exen system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which in turn was the site of the heavily populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Uviuy Exen/Legends|same name]].<ref name="IS2" />

The Uviuy Exen [[Star system/Legends|system]] lay at the intersection of two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="TEA system" /> The minor [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> known as the [[Shwuy Exchange/Legends|Shwuy Exchange]] connected the system to the [[Dankayo system/Legends|Dankayo system]]. The [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], specifically the portion that had at one point been known as the [[Corsin Run]] and had been merged into the modern Hydian Way by [[3694 BBY]], linked Uviuy Exen to the [[Eeropha system|Eeropha]] and [[Wakeelmui system/Legends|Wakeelmui systems]].<ref name="TEA system" />

==History==
{{Quote|On heavily populated worlds in those sectors, such as Uviuy Exen in Shwuy and Trammen in Harron, every single line squad has been completely armed with light repeating blasters.|A compilation of Imperial documents by Rebel Alliance Major Arhul Hextrophon|<ref name="IS2" />}}
[[File:LightRepeater-NEGWT.png|thumb|left|220px|More than half of the Imperial Army squads in the Shwuy sector were armed with light repeating blasters.]]
Although [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Uviuy Exen system became well-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the planet Uviuy Exen had already been incorporated into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA system" /> By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Uviuy Exen fell under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], more than half of all the [[line squad]]s of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] in the Shwuy sector had been armed with [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blasters]]. The latter fact was noted by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] in a compilation of Imperial documents for Alliance [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and other Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="IS2" />

The [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (6 ABY)|defeated]] the [[Zsinj's Empire|forces]] of Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] at Uviuy Exen in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] as part of a drive to push Imperials up the Hydian Way,<ref name="EGtW" /> and the Shwuy sector<ref name="EAOC" /> world had fallen under New Republic control that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. However, [[10 ABY/Legends|four years]] later, Imperial forces advancing from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Chagri system]] defeated the New Republic in [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (10 ABY)|another battle]] in the Uviuy Exen system before continuing on to the [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA system" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Placing the galaxy's major trade routes, like the Corellian Run and the Hydian Way, was the equivalent of erecting the spine. The other body parts came easier after that milestone, but it often turned into a maddening game of 'the Fakir sector's connected to the Shwuy sector, the Shwuy sector's connected to the Uoti sector&hellip;'|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|111|Blaster}}</ref>}}
[[File:Shwuy-Voyages13.png|thumb|right|250px|The Shwuy sector as depicted in "Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are"]]
The Shwuy sector was first mentioned in the [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Greg Gorden]] and published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> When discussing the writing of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' in the "[[Blaster (department)|Blaster]]" department of the [[Star Wars Insider 111|111th issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, [[Daniel Wallace]], co-author of the book, mentioned that the Shwuy sector was connected to the<ref name="Insider" /> Core Worlds'<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Uoti sector/Legends|Uoti sector]], despite no official ''[[Star Wars]]'' sources providing evidence of such connection.<ref name="Insider" /> ''The Essential Atlas'' placed the Shwuy sector's Uviuy Exen system in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA system" />

"[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]], contained a map of the Shwuy sector, in which the [[Dalron system/Legends|Dalron]], [[Gerrenthum system/Legends|Gerrenthum]], [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet]], [[Sisk system/Legends|Sisk]], and [[Vinsoth system/Legends|Vinsoth systems]] were placed, along with a [[Shwuy system]].<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref>. Since the article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process, it is considered non-[[canon]] within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> Ultimately, the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to ''The Essential Atlas'' overrode the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement by establishing that those [[Star/Legends|star]] systems were located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Ariarch sector/Legends|Ariarch sector]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat]], [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris]], [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron]], and [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]], respectively.<ref name="EAOC" />
